normalization_state.note: assess_coherence output — the user's stated sense-making; user defines meaning.

coherence_questions.note: assess_coherence output — the agent asks, never supplies.

cmo_hypotheses.note: form_cmo_hypothesis output — hypotheses at claim level, never verdicts (Valens P4/P10).

embedding_feedback_loops.note: The package's secondary map — where the routine's embedding is reinforced or stalled.

open_probes.note: Questions the package cannot answer from current evidence — surfaced, never guessed.
